g.text: Local labels C1-C24 count from the motor-side edge of the ribbon.
Mapping paused: reliable probe contact has not been established.
C9 to C15: over-range on 200 Ω.
C8-to-C9 probe contact is also uncertain.
C9 to C15: ground not yet confirmed.
Do not keep probing with oversized tips.
Use the matching exposed contacts at
the free ribbon end. Circles mark traces,
not test pads; do not pierce the coating.
Do not remove protective head covers.
The trace grouping resembles the Seiko LTP02 24-contact arrangement; electrical compatibility is unconfirmed.
The stock ADC table fits B=3950 K and R25/Rpull-up=3 exactly. Absolute resistances still need measurement.
Reference hypothesis: 30 kΩ thermistor / 10 kΩ pull-up. This is not evidence that the assembly is a Seiko part.
